m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: AH! Ye're B... big. I was once big and reckless like ye, then a few drops of digestive acid turned me into the monster ye see today.
Ye see the Acid gurgling from the Gastric Fissures? That's yer fault! If they start full-on spewing, we're all as good as dissolved!
No! Not my beautiful face! I mean... What do we do?
Such a task is usually the onus of the Globulins, but the Cabal's doings have upset the natural order of things.
Ye'll have to do their jobs for them. Wrestle Antibodies from the Globulins over there and then use 'em to soothe the Gastric Fissures. Now!
Looks like the coin-o-fate landed in yer favor. Say, just what did ye hope to accomplish with them pyrotechnics anyhow?
The name's Dynt. And you'd best steer clear o' the Notochord. That way madness lies! It's the domain of - <ITALICS>the Cabal</ITALICS>!
Oh... oh... oh, simple Sky Sailor. We're quite aware of that. Unlike you, we've come here on purpose. A very important purpose... to rescue-
Nonsense! It's no burden! I'm just happy to have people to talk to again. I'd love to help ye! OH! Would this Map be of any use to ye?
The Cabal uses Sepidious' belly as their garbage dump. Some careless Cabalist probably threw it out with yesterday's fish sticks.
Look, old man, we're on a mission here. We ain't worried about a tummy ache.
Listen, chum, sorry we disturbed you. We just needed to clear the way to the Notochord.
Pork! No need to burden old Dynt with our concerns.
Map? Wizard, let me see it!
This is more than a map. It's a detailed schematic of Sepidious Fortress! How'd you come by such a sensitive piece of information, Dynt?
Hmm. It appears Sepidious, as a fortress, is far better designed and defended than I'd expected.
This Map has already proved invaluable. Thank you, Dynt. Wizard, let me show you on the Map how I think we should proceed.
Yer blasted blasting is going to give this poor old Sky Squid indigestion!
Get Antibodies from the Stomach Globulins to soothe the Squid's Gastric Fissures, or we'll all be dissolved by Digestive Acid!
